websiteDescription:
Upgrade Your Onboard Experience with the Quick-Connect Cold Water Outlet & Wash Down Kit! Keep your deck spotless and your gear shipshape with the Scanstrut Ventura Series Quick-Connect Cold Water Outlet, built for life on the water. Whether you’re rinsing off your deck, washing down fishing gear, cleaning dive equipment, or giving your tender a quick hose-down, this outlet delivers fast, hassle-free access to cold water whenever you need it. 
Featuring a nickel-plated brass Quick-Connect coupling for effortless attachment and easy water flow, the kit includes a 3m (10ft) coiled hose and a stainless-steel shower head with two spray patterns; Jet for tough jobs and Shower for gentle rinses. Perfect for powerboats, sailboats, and any vessel that demands marine-grade performance. 
Tested to IP68 & IP69K waterproofing standards, this outlet is UV-resistant and corrosion-proof, ready to withstand harsh marine environments. Like every Ventura product, it features a compact, uniform design that integrates seamlessly to your boats design. 
Key Features: 
• Quick-Connect Nickel-Plated Brass Coupling 
• Self-Sealing Valve Water Supply Thread Size ½” BSP / G½ 
• Max Water System Pressure 8 BAR (115PSI) 
• Supplied with 3m (10ft) Coiled Hose – Multi-Pattern Stainless Steel Shower/Sprayer Head. 
• Sprayer Type – Full stainless-steel construction, Locking flow switch, multi adjustable spray pattern jet or shower. 
• IP68, IP69K Waterproof (Cover Closed) 
• Easy install 
• Standard 38mm (1.50”) Holesaw Installation 
• Mounting Gasket 
• Cover Sprung to Fully Open 180° 
• 90° Holding Bump-Feature 
• UV Resistant 
• Marine-Grade 316 Stainless Steel Components+G8
